blocks.text: MONTREAL, Canada — Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on Sunday expressed strong support for an “energy ceasefire” between Ukraine and Russia during a call with US President Donald Trump. READ: US senators say Trump’s diesel deal with Russia is illegal Carney reiterated Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky’s “call for Russia to uphold” the agreement, adding that it was “imperative that all attacks on energy infrastructure and civilians cease immediately.” Furthermore, “Canada will continue to maximise our exports of oil and diesel to the United States that yield well over a million barrels of diesel per day,” the statement said....
